newsitems.title: Fart Together’s launch is slightly delayed
newsitems.author: gamesmrkt
newsitems.contents: Hello, fellow farters,We really wanted to meet you on the raft today. However, the approval process for our game build, which we submitted to Steam for review on October 20, has not yet been completed. We’re sorry we couldn’t launch on the date we promised.We’re just as excited as you are to bring you Fart Together, our first Steam game. We’ll need a little more patience. Once the Steam team finishes its review and we receive approval, we’ll share the confirmed release date with you as soon as possible.Thank you so much for waiting, understanding, and supporting us. We’ll meet on the raft a little later than planned! 🦛— The Fart Together Team

newsitems.title: One raft, over 70,000 farters! 🦛💨
newsitems.author: gamesmrkt
newsitems.contents: Fart Together has passed 70,000 wishlists on Steam! And over 4,500 players boarded our demo's rafts at the same time. With this much gas, who knows how far we'll go! 😄Thank you to everyone who has played, had fun, shared the game with friends and supported us. ❤️We laugh a lot while testing Fart Together as a team. But watching your videos, with everyone laughing and blaming each other, made us laugh even harder. Seeing our game give you moments like these means so much to us.Let's keep this momentum going together! If you haven't already, you can support us by adding Fart Together to your wishlist and following us on Steam.Have a suggestion about the demo or the game? Or have things on your raft got a little too chaotic? Join our Discord community and share your feedback and any problems with us. Every message matters to us.See you on the raft, farters! 💨— The Fart Together Team

newsitems.title: 20,000+ Wishlists — Thank You, Farters!
newsitems.author: gamesmrkt
newsitems.contents: 3,500+ Farters on the Raft at Once and 20,000+ WishlistsWhen we released the demo, we thought a few fellow farters might have as much fun as we were having.But here we are: over 3,500 concurrent players and more than 20,000 wishlists in less than a week.As an indie team, seeing our first Steam game, Fart Together, receive more interest than we ever imagined has been incredibly exciting.Your feedback means a lot to us, and we're patching the demo based on it. We've also expanded our plans for the full game: expect more characters, more customization, longer and more challenging courses, and of course, new modes.You can share your suggestions for the game in our Discord community.If you haven't wishlisted the game yet, adding it to your wishlist is one of the best ways to support us. It helps more players discover Fart Together on Steam.The Fart Together Team
